verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS billing and Merchant of Record platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only says ingested events are 'stored in our database', with no documented choice of storage region or residency. The open-source codebase is not documented as a self-hosted residency option, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
